remote.selected_population: Owned remote transfer plus invoked final native load; shared/reused sources excluded with counts, not zeros.
caveats: Server spans are nested/descriptive and must not be added to client timeline.
Receive interval includes local reservation, reading, hashing and writing; not pure wire latency.
Admission-to-download and return-to-native gaps are not instrumented internally in these receipts.
No stage has been subtracted from actual end-to-end performance.
Within retained owned remote requests only; no causal intervention or counterfactual latency.
RPC sums are nested inside pressure start/finish; not additive with the enclosing phase.
Uninstrumented start gap includes lock/queue/controller scheduling, not pure RPC time.
